goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After pressing the Skip to main content link, the keyboard focus readout said nothing was focused, so I could not tell whether the skip worked until the next Tab landed on a link inside the content.
A button with no name at all (icon only) sits before each product title in the product gallery; I could not tell what it does.
A button is named only Prices incl. VAT plus shipping costs and sits between the product title and Add to shopping cart; its purpose is unclear and it adds a Tab stop for every product.

element.name: Prices incl. VAT plus shipping costs

findings.problem: Every Add to shopping cart button has the same name and does not say which product it adds; I had to count Tab stops to know which card I was on. The first product says Variants from 159 but the button added it directly at 174 with no variant choice.

After adding, a cart panel took focus, but it takes about 12 Tab presses to reach Go to checkout, passing wishlist, quantity, remove, an unclear button and the promo code field first. The Go to checkout link is at the very end of the panel.
A button named only (Standard) in the cart panel has no clear label; I did not know what it was for.
The first Tab after the page loaded went to Skip to main content and then an unnamed link; it took 5 Tab presses to reach the first form field, with several header links in between.
The Create a customer account checkbox is reported with value true while unchecked, which is confusing for deciding whether it is on.
Changing Country to United States silently made Postal code required and replaced the state list; nothing announced the change. The phone number I was told to give had no field anywhere on this form.

The Friendly Captcha widget put several Tab stops in the form (an I am human button, a settings button, three links) and its button was described as inside an embedded payment field, which is misleading. It also showed verified before I did anything.

element.name: I am human, Checkmark icon. Verification has been completed.

findings.problem: A cookie notice with Only technically required and Configure appears in the page text at the bottom of every page; I never found a way to reach it with Tab before it sat after the whole form, and I left it unanswered.

After pressing Continue the page was completely empty with nothing focused, with no loading message; I had to press read to see the payment step. The page then listed 2 items in the cart though I added only one, and a product named test with a discount appeared.

findings.problem: After pressing the Skip to main content link, the keyboard focus readout said nothing was focused, so I could not tell whether the skip worked until the next Tab landed on a link inside the content.
A button with no name at all (icon only) sits before each product title in the product gallery; I could not tell what it does.
A button is named only Prices incl. VAT plus shipping costs and sits between the product title and Add to shopping cart; its purpose is unclear and it adds a Tab stop for every product.

element.name: Prices incl. VAT plus shipping costs

findings.problem: Every Add to shopping cart button has the same name and does not say which product it adds; I had to count Tab stops to know which card I was on. The first product says Variants from 159 but the button added it directly at 174 with no variant choice.

After adding, a cart panel took focus, but it takes about 12 Tab presses to reach Go to checkout, passing wishlist, quantity, remove, an unclear button and the promo code field first. The Go to checkout link is at the very end of the panel.
A button named only (Standard) in the cart panel has no clear label; I did not know what it was for.
The first Tab after the page loaded went to Skip to main content and then an unnamed link; it took 5 Tab presses to reach the first form field, with several header links in between.
The Create a customer account checkbox is reported with value true while unchecked, which is confusing for deciding whether it is on.
Changing Country to United States silently made Postal code required and replaced the state list; nothing announced the change. The phone number I was told to give had no field anywhere on this form.

The Friendly Captcha widget put several Tab stops in the form (an I am human button, a settings button, three links) and its button was described as inside an embedded payment field, which is misleading. It also showed verified before I did anything.

element.name: I am human, Checkmark icon. Verification has been completed.

findings.problem: A cookie notice with Only technically required and Configure appears in the page text at the bottom of every page; I never found a way to reach it with Tab before it sat after the whole form, and I left it unanswered.

After pressing Continue the page was completely empty with nothing focused, with no loading message; I had to press read to see the payment step. The page then listed 2 items in the cart though I added only one, and a product named test with a discount appeared.
